title: Transcriptomic profiling of neutrophils in acute human brucellosis (Homo sapiens Raw sequence reads)
description: Transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood polymorphonuclear neutrophils, isolated from patients with acute brucellosis before the initiation of antibiotic treatment and three months after the completion of successful treatment (paired data analysis).
